name: The SPAR Group Ltd
source: The SPAR Group unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial results for the 26 weeks ended 27 March 2026, condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss (page 1 of the statement, booklet page 4). Figures printed in ZAR millions, scaled to units. Fetched 22 Nov 2026.

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.note: Merchandise revenue 67,482.5 less cost of sales 60,370.8 as printed. The statement labels this line gross profit; other revenue of 1,109.6 is shown separately and is included in the revenue row here.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Net operating expenses 7,542.4 less other income 61.6 equals 7,480.8, so gross profit less this row equals the printed operating profit of 740.5.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Operating profit 740.5 less other non-operating items 9.8, less net finance costs 362.9, less share of associate losses 4.8 equals 363.0.
